root_cause: Two distinct vault HMAC key files coexisted. The chain's 6 signatures (seq 31-36, key_id vault-hmac-1) were ALL produced under /var/lib/arifos/vault999-hmac.key. A systemd drop-in (40-signing-keys.conf, created 2026-09-05 05:43 for the unrelated P0-2 ACT signing-key purpose) also set ARIFOS_VAULT_HMAC_KEY_FILE to a DIFFERENT file, /opt/arifos/.secrets/vault_hmac_key. That drop-in sat inert until arifos.service restarted at 2026-09-13 09:03:43, at which point the kernel began holding a key that cannot verify its own chain. No key-rotation annotation ever authorised the second key (0 hits in this ledger), and no chain entry was ever signed with it.

evidence.verifier: /root/arifOS/tools/audit_verify.py (authoritative, run on a COPY of the chain)
evidence.code_path: arifosmcp/runtime/canonical_vault_chain.py::_vault_hmac_key reads ARIFOS_VAULT_HMAC_KEY then ARIFOS_VAULT_HMAC_KEY_FILE only - no hardcoded fallback path list, so the env var fully determines the key.

resolution.action: Reverted line 7 of /etc/systemd/system/arifos.service.d/40-signing-keys.conf to ARIFOS_VAULT_HMAC_KEY_FILE=/var/lib/arifos/vault999-hmac.key (the key that signed the chain, and the key the base unit arifos.service:37 already declared). daemon-reload + restart arifos.service.
